title: Unlocking Continuous Diffusion Language Models via Discrete Stochastic Localization
abstract: arXiv:2602.16169v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Continuous diffusion is a natural framework for non-autoregressive generation but has generally lagged behind masked discrete diffusion models (MDMs) on discrete sequence generation. We argue that continuous diffusion can effectively model discrete sequences through the joint design of noise parameterization and token representation geometry. We introduce \emph{Discrete Stochastic Localization} (DSL), a continuous-state framework that combines a stochastic localization channel with unit-sphere token embeddings, resulting in a Bayes-optimal denoiser that depends only on the noisy state, without additional timestep conditioning. A single trained denoising network then supports multiple sampling methods, from continuous denoising to masked diffusion, random-order autoregressive generation and hybrid continuous-then-discrete generation. translated_title: 通过离散随机局部化解锁连续扩散语言模型
translated_abstract: 连续扩散是非自回归生成的一个自然框架，但在离散序列生成任务上通常落后于掩码离散扩散模型（MDMs）。我们认为，通过对噪声参数化与词元表示几何结构的联合设计，连续扩散可以有效地建模离散序列。我们提出了离散随机局部化，这是一个连续状态框架，它将随机局部化通道与单位球面上的词元嵌入相结合，从而得到一个仅依赖于含噪状态的贝叶斯最优去噪器，无需额外的时间步条件。单个训练好的去噪网络即可支持多种采样方法，包括连续去噪、掩码扩散、随机顺序自回归生成以及先连续后离散的混合生成。因此，在这种连续状态框架下的并行生成并不必然意味着同步的去噪。
tldr: 提出离散随机局部化（DSL）连续状态框架，通过将随机局部化通道与单位球面词元嵌入相结合，实现了仅依赖含噪状态、无需时间步条件的贝叶斯最优去噪器，使单个去噪网络即可支持连续去噪、掩码扩散、随机顺序自回归等多种采样方法，从而让连续扩散模型在离散序列生成上有效匹敌掩码离散扩散模型。
en_tdlr: Proposes Discrete Stochastic Localization (DSL), a continuous-state framework combining a stochastic localization channel with unit-sphere token embeddings to achieve a Bayes-optimal denoiser that depends only on the noisy state without timestep conditioning, enabling a single trained network to support multiple sampling methods and making continuous diffusion effective for discrete sequence generation.
